query: SELECT e.id, e.patient_id, p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS patient_display, e.doctor_id, u.full_name AS doctor_display, e.encounter_type::text AS "encounter_type!", e.status::text AS "status!", e.created_at AS started_at, CASE WHEN e.status::text IN ('closed','completed','discharged') THEN e.updated_at ELSE NULL END AS ended_at FROM encounters e LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.id = e.patient_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = e.doctor_id WHERE e.patient_id = $1 AND e.tenant_id = $2 AND e.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days' ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
